Title: TFGTRS-4602 - Mobile PDP gallery loops forward on swipe - Hobbs and Phase Eight
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Mobile device or Chrome DevTools device emulation (e.g. Pixel 7). Product with several images.
Steps:
1. Open a PDP on a mobile viewport (Hobbs and Phase Eight).
2. Accept the cookie banner.
3. Swipe left through all the images until the last one.
4. On the last image, swipe left once more.
Expected: The gallery returns to the first image. The behaviour is the same as on desktop, where the gallery loops.

Title: TFGTRS-4602 - Mobile PDP gallery loops forward on swipe - Whistles
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Mobile device or Chrome DevTools device emulation. Product with several images. Whistles uses a different gallery component (pdp-gallery).
Steps:
1. Open a Whistles PDP on a mobile viewport.
2. Accept the cookie banner.
3. Swipe left through all the images until the last one.
4. On the last image, swipe left once more.
Expected: The gallery returns to the first image instead of staying on the last one.

Title: TFGTRS-4602 - Mobile PDP gallery loops backward on swipe - Whistles
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Mobile device or Chrome DevTools device emulation. Known observation on dev: swiping right on the first image jumped to a middle image instead of the last one.
Steps:
1. Open a Whistles PDP on a mobile viewport.
2. Accept the cookie banner.
3. On the first image, swipe right.
4. Optionally check the scroll position in the console: document.querySelector('.pdp-gallery__viewport').scrollLeft.
Expected: The gallery goes to the last image (scrollLeft close to the maximum), not to a middle image.

Title: TFGTRS-4602 - Gallery arrows (chevrons) still work and loop
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Mobile viewport and desktop viewport.
Steps:
1. Open a PDP of each brand.
2. Click the next arrow until the last image, then once more.
3. On the first image, click the previous arrow.
Expected: The arrows keep working and loop in both directions, as before the change.

Title: TFGTRS-4602 - Desktop gallery and single-image products are not affected
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available).
Steps:
1. On desktop, open a PDP of each brand and browse the gallery with the arrows and the thumbnails.
2. Open a product with a single image on mobile and try to swipe.
Expected: The desktop gallery behaves as before. A single image does not loop, flicker or throw console errors.
